```yaml
name: E2E Portals 🌐

on:
  workflow_dispatch: ~
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  e2e_portals:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v5

    - name: ⚡ Setup Golang
      uses: actions/setup-go@v6
      with:
        go-version-file: go.mod
        cache: true

    - name: Setup Rust
      uses: dsherret/rust-toolchain-file@v1

    - name: ⚡ Setup Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: '20'
        cache: 'npm'
        cache-dependency-path: tavern/internal/www/package-lock.json

    - name: 📦 Install System Dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y protobuf-compiler libssl-dev

    - name: 🔨 Build Tavern
      run: |
        go mod download
        go build -v -o tavern_bin ./tavern

    - name: 🔨 Build imixv2
      run: |
        cd implants/imixv2
        cargo build --bin imixv2 --target-dir ./build

    - name: 🔨 Build SOCKS5 Proxy
      run: |
        cd bin/socks5
        go build -v -o socks5_proxy .

    - name: 🚀 Run Tavern
      env:
        HTTP_LISTEN_ADDR: ":8000"
        LOG_FILE: "tavern.log"
      run: |
        ./tavern_bin > tavern.log 2>&1 &
        echo "Waiting for Tavern to start..."
        # Wait for port 8000
        timeout 30 sh -c 'until nc -z $0 $1; do sleep 1; done' localhost 8000

    - name: 🤖 Run Agent
      working-directory: implants/imixv2
      env:
        IMIX_CALLBACK_URI: "http://localhost:8000"
        IMIX_CALLBACK_INTERVAL: 1
      run: |
        # Fetch the pubkey and verify it's not empty
        PUBKEY=$(curl -s http://localhost:8000/status | jq -r .Pubkey)
        if [ -z "$PUBKEY" ] || [ "$PUBKEY" == "null" ]; then
          echo "Error: Could not fetch Pubkey from Tavern"
          exit 1
        fi
        export IMIX_SERVER_PUBKEY=$PUBKEY
        echo "Got pubkey: $IMIX_SERVER_PUBKEY"

        echo "Running imixv2 agent..."
        ./build/debug/imixv2 > agent.log 2>&1 &

        # Give the agent a moment to perform the initial handshake
        echo "Agent started. Waiting for initial callback..."
        sleep 5

    - name: 🎭 Install Playwright
      working-directory: tests/e2e
      run: |
        npm ci
        npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

    - name: 🧪 Run Playwright Test
      working-directory: tests/e2e
      run: |
        npx playwright test portal.spec.ts

    - name: 📥 Get Portal ID
      id: get_portal_id
      run: |
        PORTAL_ID=$(curl -s http://localhost:8000/graphql \
          -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
          -d '{"query":"query { portals { id } }"}' \
          | jq -r '.data.portals[0].id')
        echo "portal_id=$PORTAL_ID" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

    - name: 🚀 Start SOCKS5 Proxy
      run: |
        cd bin/socks5
        ./socks5_proxy --portal-id="${{ steps.get_portal_id.outputs.portal_id }}" > socks5.log 2>&1 &

    - name: 🚀 Start Mock HTTP Server
      run: |
        python3 -m http.server 8080 --directory /tmp &

    - name: 🧪 Verify Data Integrity
      run: |
        # Create a test file
        echo "Hello, World!" > /tmp/testfile.txt
        
        # Calculate checksum
        CHECKSUM_ORIGINAL=$(md5sum /tmp/testfile.txt | cut -d' ' -f1)
        
        # Transfer via SOCKS5 proxy
        curl --socks5-hostname localhost:1080 http://localhost:8080/testfile.txt -o /tmp/transferred.txt
        
        # Calculate transferred checksum
        CHECKSUM_TRANSFERRED=$(md5sum /tmp/transferred.txt | cut -d' ' -f1)
        
        # Compare
        if [ "$CHECKSUM_ORIGINAL" = "$CHECKSUM_TRANSFERRED" ]; then
          echo "✅ Data integrity verified!"
        else
          echo "❌ Data integrity check failed!"
          echo "Original: $CHECKSUM_ORIGINAL"
          echo "Transferred: $CHECKSUM_TRANSFERRED"
          exit 1
        fi
```
